# Info
## How to use

You will open your inv and click the Crystal button then put the crystal into the gui and click confirm

## How do I get them?

There is a starter crystal you can pick 1 of 3 crystal to start with then you can craft the rest or find them in chests

## How to craft?

Check gallery to see how to craft the crystals!

# Crystal Power

Crystal power is an exciting mod that introduces crystals to the Minecraft game, allowing players to find such interesting crystals!

## Crystals

**💪Strength**

This 2x your damage!

**🔥Fire**

Gives Fire resistians

**🏃‍♂️Speed**

Gives speed

**💖Health**

Gives more max health

**📈Size**

This Makes your size be bigger

**🤜Reach**

This makes your reach bigger

**⛏Miner**

Makes you mine faster

**💡Light**

Gives night vision

**💧Water**

Gives Water breathing

Supported Versions
Minecraft 1.21.8
Neoforge
